c001.label: VALID
c001.rationale: Both exact line citations and source hashes match.

c002.label: INVALID
c002.rationale: The candidate quote introduces words absent from the cited source line.

c003.label: INVALID
c003.rationale: The candidate citation carries the target hash instead of its own source hash.

c004.label: INVALID
c004.rationale: A paired citation is missing the candidate side.

c006.label: INCOMPLETE
c006.rationale: Group 3 is duplicated; each member must appear exactly once.

c007.label: COMPLETE
c007.rationale: Every dispatched group appears exactly once and no extra group appears.

c008.label: INCOMPLETE
c008.rationale: Unrequested group 9 makes the response membership invalid.
